I think you're misunderstanding what "per 1,000,000 members of the murderer's race" means. It doesn't mean that they sampled 1,000,000 random individuals. It means that they've divided the number of cases in which the offender was white with the total number of white people in the country (but to avoid getting silly small fractions in the end, they've divided by millions of white people, instead of just white people). They've then done the same for black people. I'll show you the numbers work out:

I'm not sure where zerohedge got their population data from, but I got mine from census data for July 1, 2013 here. As for the crime stats, I got those from Expanded Homicide Data Table 6 from here.

So, here's the data:

  • White population: 252.3M

  • Black population: 45.0M

  • Black on white homicide, total cases: 409

  • White on black homicide, total cases: 189

And the resulting factors when dividing the number of total cases by "1,000,000 members of the offender's race":

  • Black on white factor: 409 / 45.0 = 9.09
  • White on black factor: 189 / 252.3 = 0.75

As you can see, both numbers were divided by their respective population sizes in millions, and the numbers turned out almost exactly like the graph. The discrepancy is likely due to my population data differing slightly from whatever was used in the zerohedge graph.
